records.title: White Matter Hyperintensities and Hypobaric Exposure
records.locator: Subjects, MRI analysis of clinical NDCS, and Table 2
records.note: Two of 83 selected altitude chamber operations staff reported a history of mission-related neurological DCS symptoms. None of the study subjects reported NDCS from periodic qualification chamber training. The paper supplies no count of qualification exposures and no common clinical surveillance window. Sixteen of 105 selected U-2 pilots reported mission-related neurological DCS symptoms in Methods. Table 2 separately excludes 22 pilots by subtraction for its MRI analysis without clinical NDCS. The publication gives no participant crosswalk explaining the difference.

records.title: White Matter Integrity in High-Altitude Pilots Exposed to Hypobaria
records.note: Of 106 pilots who accepted, four were excluded from the DTI analysis and 102 were analyzed. The report gives 22 pilots (21%) with mission-related neurological DCS symptom history. The scope of that numerator relative to the DTI exclusions and the individual overlap with the 2014 report are unresolved.
